verdict.rationale: The ESD runs online employer services (eServices and EAMS for quarterly tax and wage filing), so an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows no MCP server: there is no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, and the transactional portal sits behind a SecureAccess Washington login. With no evidence for an applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
